item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00400","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 18 months plus 6 years as 8.5 years instead of 7.5.","case2_error":"States the correct speed formula but gives unsupported 2.5 km/h; the correct speed is 2 km/h.","reason":"Case 1 explicitly miscalculates a written expression; case 2 provides an incorrect number without showing its numerical calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00401","case1_error":"Uses 32 instead of 24 for the first group and includes an unsupported extra 64 in the final sum.","case2_error":"Subtracts two separate remaining amounts, (21−5)−(21−7), instead of subtracting both eaten amounts from 21.","reason":"Case 1 corrupts group totals and adds an extraneous term; case 2 constructs an incorrect relation between two remainders.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00402","case1_error":"Gives an incorrect final $15 after the correct expression (36 × $0.75) − $16, which equals $11.","case2_error":"No mathematical error: correctly uses inverse speed and time ratios to obtain Rickey's 30 minutes.","reason":"Case 2 correctly answers the question; its reference incorrectly applies the speed ratio directly to time.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00403","case1_error":"No mathematical error: correctly calculates Micah's 13.5 hours, Jake's 18 hours, and the 40.5-hour sum.","case2_error":"Reports total walking time, 6 hours, as additional time despite correctly calculating 3 additional hours.","reason":"Case 1 is correct; its reference incorrectly treats lower speed as requiring less time.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00404","case1_error":"Uses purchase cost per egg instead of the 20-cent selling price to calculate capital recovery.","case2_error":"Treats 12 eggs per basket as eggs per person and counts 26 people instead of 20.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes cost for selling price; case 2 misassigns the basket quantity to people and miscounts participants.","judgment":"different"}]}
